summary: Question answered: a Rust agent with A2A/AG-UI/A2UI + MCP Apps DOES change the calculus — for delivery, not for the debate premise. MCP Apps went GA 2026-01-26 (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Goose). Google + MCP Apps co-creators published three A2UI x MCP patterns 2026-06-17; 'A2UI over MCP' uses application/a2ui+json over a2ui:// and is BACKEND-AGNOSTIC, which removes the TypeScript-SDK objection for a Rust agent entirely. Key in-repo finding: native-agent already speaks all three protocols but its agent-mcp crate is an MCP CLIENT ONLY — the server surface is the real gap, and surface-bridge (:7890, live) already proves UI-over-MCP works in our stack. A better UI does NOT rescue the persona-debate idea: the NeurIPS martingale proof stands. Dynamic MCP App generation is RCE by construction — recommend dynamic A2UI JSON constrained to a component catalog, never dynamic raw HTML.
